content:
# I hate ends and endings.

It's the change.

I get used to things, comfortable even. When things end I want to keep hold of that familiar feeling. I don't want to move on. Even when reaching "The End" I want to know what happens next.

Yes, but...

Characters don't stop existing just because the story is done.
